description: Phase 8 reproducibility suite. Visual uses the retained Phase 3 Celeb-DF v2 official-test raw prediction JSONL. Other axes are explicit not_applicable entries because no authorised frozen labelled manifests are available in this repository.

experiments.name: audio-spoofing
experiments.reason: No authorised frozen labelled audio-spoofing manifest is available. Celeb-DF v2 official 518 videos have no audio stream, so audio F1/AUC/EER/FPR/FNR/calibration metrics are not claimed.

experiments.name: fact-checking
experiments.reason: No authorised frozen labelled claim/evidence/fact-check manifest with real ASR/OCR/search provenance is available. Existing fixtures are controlled Mock pipeline tests, not factual performance data.

experiments.name: three-axis-fusion
experiments.reason: No frozen labelled multi-axis manifest exists. Mock content/provenance axes are forbidden from forming conflict or fusion signals, so fusion metrics are not claimed.

experiments.name: ablation
experiments.reason: Ablation requires frozen labelled component manifests for at least two real non-mock axes. Only the visual Celeb-DF v2 official-test prediction file is available.

experiments.name: robustness
experiments.reason: No authorised frozen robustness perturbation manifest is available. Difficult or perturbed samples are not generated or removed in Phase 8.
